tickets.title: Author the item catalogue: ~60 unique items
tickets.description: Hand-made, permanent, named. Every gear piece is a trade-off, never a pure upgrade.

tickets.title: Author the notable item tier: ~200 items
tickets.description: Second tier below the uniques, above generic mundane.

tickets.title: Catalogue distribution by axiom
tickets.description: The seed decides where items are and who holds them. The Mysteries stocks sanctuaries; Orichalcum buries in mines.

tickets.title: Capability loot: traversal gear as map access
tickets.description: Diving gear, climbing kit, cold rig. The strongest reward in a generated world and the primary progression gate.

tickets.title: Information loot: maps, charts, ciphers, keys
tickets.description: Cheap to author, disproportionately loved. ~10% of loot.

tickets.title: Enforce loot class ratios
tickets.description: ~55% consumables and charges, 20% materials, 10% information, 10% coin, 5% gear.

tickets.title: Dual currency: coin and the Law hard currency
tickets.description: Coin buys bread, charge buys power. One data-driven swap changes the whole economy's feel.

tickets.title: Per-Law currency implementations
tickets.description: Refined ore, bottled vitality, spellbooks, node deeds, remaining charges, transferable debt.

tickets.title: Stash points, carts and caches
tickets.description: Never make the answer be walking back. The question is what to leave behind, not how many trips.

tickets.title: Economy sinks: faction dues and bribes
Economy sink: rebuilding settlements, bridges and routes
tickets.description: The best sink in the genre because it changes the map visibly.

tickets.title: Regional merchant stock and pricing from scarcity
tickets.description: Driven by the axiom schema's economy.scarce and economy.abundant blocks plus faction control and route status.

tickets.title: Trade routes affect prices when cut
tickets.description: The quest layer and economy layer become one system. Nearly free once the ledger exists.

tickets.title: Tune to 'briefly rich two or three times per campaign'
tickets.description: Balance pass across faucets and drains.
